name: Shared Wisdom
description: Grant boons to allies whenever you use a Legendary Entity Skill, depending on which skill was used.

facts.description: Movement speed increased by 33%; stacks duration.
Incoming strike damage decreased by 33%; stacks duration.

prefix.description:
Channel revitalizing energy that heals you with every pulse. While channeling, you take reduced strike and condition damage.

<c=@abilitytype>Resonance.</c> If Legendary Centaur Stance is equipped, you additionally heal allies around you during channeling, and you take reduced strike and condition damage for a short amount of time after channeling completes.

Send an unblockable fragment of Razah toward the targeted area. When the fragment reaches its target, shadowstep to its position, dealing damage to enemies in the area. If it hits, you can use this skill up to two more times with no energy cost or casting time.

<c=@abilitytype>Resonance.</c> If Legendary Assassin Stance is equipped, this skill deals additional damage and removes boons if only one enemy was struck by this attack.

facts.description: Cannot be knocked down, pushed back, pulled, launched, stunned, dazed, floated, sunk, feared, or taunted.

prefix.description:
Break out of stun, damaging and weakening enemies close to you. Gain boons if this skill strikes at least one enemy. Remove additional energy if this skill was used to break a stun. 

<c=@abilitytype>Resonance.</c> If Legendary Dwarf Stance is equipped, the additional energy cost for breaking stuns is reduced, and the boons are also granted to allies in a radius around you.

facts.description: Incoming condition damage decreased by 33%; stacks duration.

prefix.description:
Remove conditions on yourself, then fire projectiles that inflict conditions at random enemies within your radius, based on the number of conditions removed. 

<c=@abilitytype>Resonance.</c> If Legendary Demon Stance is equipped, the maximum number of projectiles is always fired regardless of conditions removed, and all projectiles are fired at the closest enemy instead.

Spawn a Fragment of Razah at your targeted location. Both you and the fragment attack with a scythe, damaging and inflicting conditions on foes at your locations. Gain might for each enemy struck.

<c=@abilitytype>Resonance.</c> This skill gains bonus effects depending on the legend equipped in the other slot.
